notes.title: The 6th Grimoire Has Arrived!
notes.content:
A new Grimoire has been added!
Unlock Condition: Achieve 13 wins with any Grimoire.



A brand-new deck featuring new cards has been added, marking the arrival of the 6th Grimoire.
Discover and master new cards and links to challenge your battles.
You may even encounter something reminiscent of that card you always wanted to use but couldn’t.


[hr][/hr]

Balance

notes.title: A New Grimoire Has Been Added!
notes.content:
A New Grimoire Has Been Added!
Unlock Condition: Achieve a total of 50 victories.

A brand-new grimoire has been added, featuring approximately 40 new cards and around 60 new links.

Make the most of the unique traits of the new special cards and take on new challenges!

Fixed a bug with win tracking for the fourth grimoire
